title: Material Blend 3-Mix Duo #10 (스테인드글라스+왁스+드래곤비늘 / UV네온+나비날개비늘+왁스)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. TWO women standing side by side, each with her own multi-material blended body.

#1: THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, mid 40s goddess, powerlifter bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — immense powerful thighs and shoulders built with real strength, a thick solid waist, overwhelming muscular bulk layered with soft curves everywhere, silver-white natural hair swept into a high sculpted crown — her body carries 3 different materials at once, each claiming roughly an equal irregular organic share of her body rather than any straight line, zones arranged diagonally and asymmetrically. solid thick stained glass fused to her form, hundreds of small individual panes each no larger than a coin, BLAZING ELECTRIC MAGENTA and VIVID SILVER panes alternating in a dense irregular mosaic, dark lead-line seams webbing between every pane dominates zone 1. molten wax flowing and set directly over her own skin, BLAZING DEEP VIOLET wax streams pooling and hardening, VIVID ROSE translucent drip-ridges catching the light dominates zone 2. dragon scales (large thick armor-plate scales, each one substantial and sharply faceted), BLAZING METALLIC SILVER scale formations, VIVID PALE BLUE scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow dominates zone 3. Wherever any two zones meet, the boundary is soft, diagonal or curving rather than a straight line, the materials interweaving and overlapping gradually across an irregular blended border a few inches wide, elements of each scattered into the neighbouring zone, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every material fused to or erupting from her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Pose: full frontal wide stance, both fists pressing outer hips outward to absolute maximum — most extreme powerlifter bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
#1: extreme platform heels/boots blending the relevant materials at her feet, extra long nails each matching whichever zone that hand falls in.

#2: THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, late 20s goddess, curvy petite physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — smallest most compact frame possible yet curves exploding at absolute maximum in every direction, bubble butt projecting dramatically backward from the tiny frame, thighs so thick they dwarf the petite frame, silver-white locs cascading to her waist — her body carries 3 different materials at once, each claiming roughly an equal irregular organic share of her body rather than any straight line, zones arranged diagonally and asymmetrically. UV-reactive neon bodypaint, invisible under standard light but supernova burst formations in ELECTRIC GOLD and MAGENTA glowing at full intensity under her own dedicated UV blacklight dominates zone 1. butterfly scales (thousands of microscopic powder-fine scales layered like overlapping roof tiles, each scale individually distinct catching its own glint), BLAZING ELECTRIC BLUE scale formations, VIVID DEEP BLACK scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow dominates zone 2. molten wax flowing and set directly over her own skin, BLAZING DEEP EMERALD wax streams pooling and hardening, VIVID GOLD translucent drip-ridges catching the light dominates zone 3. Wherever any two zones meet, the boundary is soft, diagonal or curving rather than a straight line, the materials interweaving and overlapping gradually across an irregular blended border a few inches wide, elements of each scattered into the neighbouring zone, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every material fused to or erupting from her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Pose: strong hip pop right, both hands pressing sides of hips outward simultaneously arching back to extreme — most extreme curvy petite silhouette ever displayed. A standard hard key light illuminates most of her body; a separate dedicated UV blacklight illuminates the UV-reactive zone specifically, making it glow at full intensity while the rest reads under normal light.
#2: extreme platform heels/boots blending the relevant materials at her feet, extra long nails each matching whichever zone that hand falls in.

Environment: MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient.
All: Extreme macro detail on every material and every blended transition. CRITICAL: all 2 women's legs must show FULL BODY ART coverage from hip to ankle to toe with NO bare untattooed skin visible anywhere. TWO completely different extreme physiques must CONTRAST and DOMINATE every inch of frame. 8K portrait 3:4 aspect ratio.
